headline: 威尼斯影展新片評論
context: 捷克導演米羅・雷莫（Miro Remo）的新片《Better Go Mad in the Wild》深入捷克鄉間，記錄一對隱居兄弟看似荒誕卻充滿智慧的日常生活，全片由一頭遭宰殺的公牛負責旁白，風格相當超現實。威尼斯影展另一部新片《Bunker》，則找來克魯茲（Penélope Cruz）與巴登（Javier Bardem）主演，導演佛羅里安・澤勒（Florian Zeller）講述一名建築師為科技富豪打造豪華地堡的故事，不過評論認為，就連這兩位實力派演員也救不了這部劇本薄弱的驚悚片。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Venice film festival: An architect (Javier Bardem) alienates his book editor wife (Penélope Cruz) when he agrees to build a luxurious bunker for a tech billionaire Even the formidable pairing of Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem can’t save this new movie from writer-director Florian Zeller – his first created directly for the screen, and not adapted from his own stage original. It’s shallow and unsatisfying, a drama without the intimate, authentic passion of his previous movies like The Father (2021) or The Son (2022). Bunker has nothing that interesting or original to say about its metaphorically showcased theme of alienation and inequality; the central relationship is left unexplored in favour of so-so home-invasion suspense styling – although one extended marital-argument scene showed what might have been achieved if their relationship was the film’s point – and the violent finale ending is outrageously glib, silly and unconvincing. An off-camera paramedic or doctor actually has to be heard explaining in a brief sentence afterwards what is supposed to have happened. Very lame. Continue reading...
sources.title: Bunker review – Cruz and Bardem just can’t dig Florian Zeller’s shallow thriller out of a hole

捷克導演米羅・雷莫（Miro Remo）的新片《Better Go Mad in the Wild》深入捷克鄉間，記錄一對隱居兄弟看似荒誕卻充滿智慧的日常生活，全片還由一頭遭宰殺的公牛負責旁白，風格相當超現實。威尼斯影展另一部新片《Bunker》，找來克魯茲（Penélope Cruz）與巴登（Javier Bardem）主演，導演佛羅里安・澤勒（Florian Zeller）講述建築師為科技富豪蓋地堡的故事，評論認為，就連這兩位實力派演員也救不了這部劇本薄弱的驚悚片。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 8 日至 9 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 威尼斯影展這幾天有兩部新片引發討論。第一部是捷克導演的新作，記錄一對隱居兄弟看似荒誕卻充滿智慧的日常生活，旁白還是由一頭遭宰殺的公牛負責，風格非常超現實。第二部叫《Bunker》，找來克魯茲和巴登主演，講一名建築師為科技富豪蓋地堡的故事，不過評論說，就連這兩位實力派演員，也救不了劇本薄弱的驚悚片。
